                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Neri's field test

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An optional nonlethal test. Neri uses five of their own supplies to investigate and follow witnessed Village/Shack routes. The Shack is private shelter. A missed trail ends the search; there is no unattended damage or obligation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Sela's marked-trail test

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An optional signature-tracking test. Sela can sense your agreed ink mark in Village and the Shack, spending their own focus. Ordinary cover or removing the mark breaks detection. The Shack remains shelter; old witnessed leads can still be searched.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Timed heavenly writ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A reversible heavenly-authority demonstration. Four played minutes after accepting, an envoy can locate and manifest beside you anywhere in this realm. Ordinary concealment and the Shack do not block this writ. The summons waits through combat and has no response deadline or unattended damage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Workshop consequence review

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Arrange a review triggered by completing your shared workshop. Its reviewer can locate the owner by the agreed site writ. No encounter occurs before the actual assembly completes. This reversible nonlethal proof has no unattended damage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      star_border Village
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The village path lies in darkness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Medium-sized village, built at the foot of the mountains, with rocks preventing any expansions towards north. It's surrounded by many fields, most of them infested by huge rats. There is a relatively calm, somewhat small river south of it with no bridges over it, and with some old structures on the other side, clearly not used for years if not longer. Many villagers seem to have nothing to do and are just sitting around.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Wolf rat: physical attack preparation; 0% of base attack added as defense per hit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Village patrol · Apprentice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Take a loaned lantern and baton through the native patrol job below. Each full round pays 50 base coins; the report bonus is shown below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Tessa, your patrol colleague: “I’ll lend you our lantern and baton. Walk the whole two-hour round, then bring them back.”

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Next: Dependable worker. Complete 2 full shifts (0/2). Return 2 completed-shift kits (0/2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Watchcraft: known no · practiced no (0/5 meditation minutes) · executable now no.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Next full patrol: 50 coins. Read Tessa’s notes or learn from her in person, then rehearse calm sector scanning during five minutes of Village meditation for the tool-dependent report bonus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Iona, visiting parcel clerk

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Last met: Village

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Eda, sluice fitter

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Last met: Village fitting bench

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Known from your instrument meeting and received work accounts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Neri, resident kit binder

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Known from your home meeting and received work accounts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Optional home-world pacing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Home-world pacing. Hunger off (native pacing). Weather off (native weather). Total XP ×1.000. Temperature +0°C over native temperature. Native rain is retained.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Both start off to preserve existing pacing. Hunger drains over eight played hours and changes earned XP from 80% to 100%; native food refills it. Weather adds small outdoor temperature changes and fog gives 95% earned XP. Home world only; no offline drain. Turning an option off freezes its meter or duration.
